summary: This stage conducted an exhaustive static audit of Paper P against its released code repository and data files. It identified key critical implementation defects, including that the grammatical gender classifier was a LinearSVC rather than the claimed LDA, an operator-precedence bug in semantic PCA centering (`a + b/2`), and the absence of evaluation code for word similarity, word translation, and Spearman correlations. It also catalogued severe repository dependency gaps (39 missing input paths) and data quality problems such as substantial gender list intersection and non-noun noise. The audit appropriately refrained from claiming end-to-end execution without the unreleased embeddings, delivering a thoroughly documented and well-calibrated critique.
